subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – custom domain connection
body_text:
Hi Arjun,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us because your custom domain shop.testfunnel.example had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, even though your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link.

What was completed during the call:
- Following our guidance, you opened the domain in an incognito window and checked its status in your dashboard, which showed "Not connected". The same error in incognito ruled out a browser cache issue.
- You deleted the old A record for shop and added a CNAME record for shop. After that, the dashboard showed the domain as connected and shop.testfunnel.example loaded.
- You then deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value. You confirmed that both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version now load your funnel.

What we discussed:
- An old A record for shop, pointing to an old server address, was blocking the connection, and a second www record pointed somewhere else. Each needed a CNAME using the target value in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.
- The padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting the domain.

What we'll do next:
- The morning after our call, we will check that the secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-02

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
